description: Delete one email forward, named by its `address` and `forward_to` (from `list_email_forwards`; an address can forward to several mailboxes, so both are needed). When it was the domain's last forward and there are no email hosting mailboxes, Porkbun's forwarding MX and SPF records are removed too (`dnsRecordsRemoved: true`), so mail to the domain stops being accepted.

forward_to.description: The destination mailbox of the forward to delete.

name: delete_email_forward
title: Delete Email Forward
